LESSON: SIGN READING 7.2.1 INTENSIVE SIGN READING: VISUALS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.2: Sign Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Sign Reading: Visuals
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Sign Reading: Visuals, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How does observation of actual items help us understand what we are taught?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Sign Reading: Visuals together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: Learner develops the skill of digital citizenship as they observe safety precautions and practices when searching for

different information conveyed through visuals online.

● Citizenship: Learner develops national and cultural identity skills as discuss national symbols such as the national flag and currency.

Values:
Patriotism: learners develop self awareness skills as they discuss visuals of national importance like the national flag and the Kenyan

currency.

Link to other Subjects

The learner relates the concept of visuals to their learning in other learning areas such as Creative Arts and Sports, Social Studies,

Mathematics and Integrated Science.
